Tools & Technologies: Backend: Node.js, Express.js; Database: MongoDB; Caching: Redis; Messaging / Queue: Apache Kafka; Streaming: HLS (implementation level); Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS.

modules.title: Project 2: Quick Commerce Platform (Blinkit-style + AI)
topics: What You Will Build: Full e-commerce flow (products, cart, orders), Real-time rider tracking on map, Order lifecycle management (state machine), Inventory and product management, Search and filtering system, Multi-channel notification system.
AI Features: AI-powered product recommendations, Semantic product search using vector embeddings, AI agent for user assistance (chat/query handling).

Tools & Technologies: Backend: Node.js, Express.js; Database: MongoDB; Caching: Redis; Real-time: WebSockets; Messaging: Apache Kafka; Search: Elasticsearch; Vector Search: Vector DB (for embeddings-based search); AI Integration: LLM APIs / AI agent framework (basic usage); Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Redux Toolkit.

modules.title: Phase 7: DevOps - Module 1: DevOps Foundations & Linux

Linux essentials: filesystem hierarchy, permissions (chmod, chown), processes & systemd
Package managers (apt, yum/dnf) and core networking utilities (ss, curl, dig, nslookup)
Bash scripting for automation: variables, loops, conditionals, cron scheduling

modules.title: Module 2: Git & Version Control Mastery
topics: Git internals: objects, refs, the staging area, and how commits actually work
Branching strategies: Gitflow, trunk-based development, GitHub Flow
Merge vs. rebase, cherry-pick, stash, and git bisect for debugging history
Pull request workflows, code review etiquette, signed commits

topics: TCP/IP refresher, subnetting and CIDR notation (focused on what DevOps actually needs)
DNS resolution chain, TTL, and common record types (A, CNAME, MX)
Load balancing concepts: round-robin, least-connection, sticky sessions
SSL/TLS handshake, certificate management, Let's Encrypt automation
Reverse proxies and API gateways at a high level

modules.title: Module 4: CI/CD with Jenkins & GitHub Actions
topics: CI vs. continuous delivery vs. continuous deployment - what each really means
Jenkins architecture, Declarative Pipelines (Jenkinsfile), shared libraries
GitHub Actions: workflows, runners, matrix builds, OIDC auth, reusable workflows
Secrets management, build caching, parallel jobs

topics: Container vs. VM internals: namespaces, cgroups, union filesystems

Docker networking modes and volume management
Docker Compose for multi-service local development

modules.title: Module 6: Kubernetes Core
topics: Architecture: control plane, etcd, kube-scheduler, kubelet, kube-proxy
Core workloads: Pods, ReplicaSets, Deployments, DaemonSets, StatefulSets

modules.title: Module 7: Kubernetes in Production

Autoscaling: HPA, VPA, and the Cluster Autoscaler
Network policies and Pod Security Standards

modules.title: Module 8: Helm & GitOps
topics: Helm charts: templates, values, hooks, chart dependencies
GitOps principles: declarative state, pull-based reconciliation
ArgoCD: app-of-apps pattern, sync policies, automated rollbacks
Flux CD as an alternative - push vs. pull deployment models

modules.title: Module 9: Terraform & Infrastructure as Code
topics: IaC concepts: declarative vs. imperative, idempotency, drift
Terraform building blocks: providers, resources, state, workspaces, modules
Remote state with S3 + DynamoDB locking, Terraform Cloud
Writing reusable modules and managing multi-environment infra
Ansible for configuration management - playbooks, roles, inventories
Terraform vs. Ansible vs. Pulumi - when to reach for which

modules.title: Module 10: Cloud Platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure)
topics: Core services side-by-side: compute (EC2/GCE/VMs), networking (VPC), storage (S3/GCS/Blob)
Managed Kubernetes: EKS, GKE, AKS - provisioning, node pools, upgrades
IAM, service accounts, and least-privilege role design
Cost optimisation: spot/preemptible instances, right-sizing, reserved capacity
Project: Provision an EKS cluster with Terraform and deploy a Java app via ArgoCD

modules.title: Module 11: Observability - Metrics, Logs & Traces
topics: The three pillars of observability and when each matters
Prometheus: scrape model, exporters, service discovery, recording & alerting rules
PromQL essentials: rate(), histogram_quantile(), alert expressions
Grafana dashboards, data sources, and alert routing
Log aggregation with Loki / ELK; structured logging and correlation IDs

modules.title: Module 12: DevSecOps, SRE & Capstone
topics: Shift-left security: SAST (SonarQube), DAST (OWASP ZAP), dependency scanning (Snyk, Dependabot)
Secrets management: GitLeaks detection, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager
Container hardening: non-root users, read-only filesystems, distroless images
SRE practices: SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, toil elimination
Incident management: on-call runbooks, PagerDuty/OpsGenie, blameless retrospectives
Chaos engineering with LitmusChaos / Chaos Mesh
Capstone: Java app -> CI/CD -> container -> Kubernetes -> fully monitored & secured

data.description: Welcome to the ultimate guide to Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) in C++! This comprehensive course is designed to take you from the basic principles of programming to a level of proficiency where you can confidently solve complex computational problems. We will start with a solid foundation in C++, explore fundamental and advanced data structures, master key algorithmic paradigms, and even touch upon modern applications.
